subject: Otyugh
picture: A large dungeon scavenger. One fat round body. Three thick legs. Two long rubbery tentacles from the sides ending in flat spiked pads, not hands. One tall stalk on top of the body with two eyes next to each other on that same stalk. One wide mouth on the lower front of the body. No second mouth, no face eyes on the body, no person arms. Sacks and bones on the floor. Stone ceiling, walls, closed door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
